ImageDescription.value:
May 2006 - Our ship had to be in Vancouver on Sunday to start the summer Alaskan cruise season. We parked at Victoria for the day. Not too special for us, Victoria does make an excellent stop for tourists.

To read some about the trip, visit <a href="http://www.dennissylvesterhurd.com/blog/2006_05_07_vault.html#114701729933042042" target="_new">my eJournal and images</a>.
